_why: storyboard BEFORE the build (4_SCRIPT v2, script-critic + brief-keeper PASS): the 11 key moments incl. all 5 wows, reference | PLAN card - previz stills come with the painted 2D world (build list), never shown as finished

moments.line: cold open / the last picture first (shot 0b)
moments.camera: on the beam axis at the lamp, h 13.7 d 6 fov 58
moments.her: THE silhouette: hangs her whole weight on the brass of the lamp (pull-heavy-object 1.9)
moments.fx: white-gold fills the frame, she a black shape - 6 frames
moments.light: the beam is the only light

moments.line: frame 0.5: her eye opens under the black surface (shot 1)
moments.camera: from below her cheek, h 0.35 d 0.75 fov 50, pull-back arc
moments.her: eye snaps open, glides up the lighthouse cable
moments.fx: the beam sweeps the surface above like a blade (30 % width), a pulse sparks up the cable
moments.light: black-navy, her violet dots, the white beam far above

moments.line: hit 1: the pulse blows up the cable (shot 5)
moments.camera: low converging-cable frame, h 0.4 d 1.2 fov 60, roll -8, crash in
moments.her: LUNGES up the cable at the light (roar 1.0), mouth open
moments.fx: cable white-hot, two-tone background 2 frames (she keeps her colours), shake 5
moments.light: the pulse is the key light

moments.line: the war cry after the stop (shot 28)
moments.camera: ECU, h at her mouth d 0.62 fov 48, roll +6, 3-frame push
moments.her: screams INTO the lens, claws at us (roar 1.0), mouth wide open
moments.fx: ring bursts past the glass, ink detonation with a hole at her face, chroma 3, shake 5; the ink line climbs with her measured notes (red heads 62.75-64.45)
moments.light: two-tone paper / ink + her violet + one red

moments.camera: crane straight up from 0.6 to 6 m in 1.2 s
moments.her: arms raised, head back, mouth open on the held B5
moments.fx: a violet-white pillar of her light, exactly as long as the note
moments.light: her pillar the only light in the storm

moments.camera: close on her, the black cloud edge sweeps across the lens first
moments.her: pings at the rock (casting-spell 1.0), mouth open
moments.fx: the ping hits the rock and SHATTERS into 12 two-tone shards flying at the lens, stutter on twos, shake 4

moments.line: the sky clears: the one moon (shot 48)
moments.camera: wide from behind her, h 1.2 d 5
moments.her: stands in the surf, looking up
moments.fx: clouds part in 30 frames, the moon 45 % of the frame over the lighthouse
moments.light: moonlight rims her; the beauty that mocks her (her rain call wrong again)

moments.camera: low on the ledge, d 2.8, roll -10
moments.her: SUPERHERO LANDING on the rock (swing-backflip-to-superhero-pose 1.9), rain halo
moments.fx: lamp flash two-tone, shake 5, a ring of rain, ink slash

moments.line: false win: the beam passes the lens (shot 66)
moments.camera: on the lens-side beam axis, medium d 3
moments.fx: the beam swings and PASSES the lens in 10 frames, flash, shake 4

moments.line: THE LAST HIT: the beam stops on you (shot 83)
moments.camera: the cold-open camera: on the beam axis, h 13.7 d 6 fov 58
moments.her: THE silhouette (same as 0.2 s): her whole weight on the lamp
moments.fx: white-gold 100 % for 3 frames, chroma, shake 5, held; overshoot and settle

moments.line: the ink night: her dots become stars (shot 86)
moments.camera: close on her face, slow breathing push
moments.her: looks at us from the lamp, mouth closed
moments.fx: the sky inked over, 60-90 drawn stars burst from her dots on the biggest transient of the song
moments.light: ink black, violet stars, the gold beam
